events.title: Launch
events.detail: Too heavy to fly straight to Saturn, it borrows speed from four planets.

events.title: Venus flyby 1
events.detail: First gravity assist: a swing past Venus.

events.title: Venus flyby 2
events.detail: Back to Venus for a second boost.

events.title: Earth flyby
events.detail: Whips past Earth at about 1,200 km altitude.

events.title: Jupiter flyby
events.detail: Last boost, and joint observations with the Galileo orbiter.

events.title: Arrives at Saturn
events.detail: Fires its engine through a gap in the rings to enter orbit.

events.title: Huygens released
events.detail: The European Huygens probe separates and heads for Titan.

events.title: Huygens lands on Titan
events.detail: The most distant landing ever, on a moon with methane lakes.

events.title: Grand Finale begins
events.detail: 22 dives through the gap between Saturn and its rings.

events.title: Final plunge
events.detail: Cassini dives into Saturn, sending data until the end.
